message.content: No, there is no indication in the provided data that Li Hua had previously asked Yuriko to play music together. The first mention of Yuriko is when Wolfgang introduces her to Li Hua, stating, "Hey guys! Just wanted to introduce you both since I think you'll hit it off! Yuriko, this is Wolfgang, my best buddy." After this introduction, Wolfgang proposes, "By the way, we should all plan a jam session together sometime! It would be so much fun to play music and hang out!" and Li Hua agrees, "Absolutely! I'm down for a jam session! I love making music with others. Just let me know when you want to get together!" Thus, it appears Wolfgang was the one who initially suggested the idea of a jam session including Yuriko, following the introduction by Wolfgang. There is no prior mention of Li Hua inviting Yuriko to play music together before Wolfgang's suggestion.
